name: redis-hist
description: Redis with an append-only file; histories checked for linearizability and lost appends.

text./etc/redis.conf:
port 6379
bind 127.0.0.1
dir /data/redis
save ""
appendonly yes
appendfsync always
hz 1
dynamic-hz no

shell:
rc() { timeout 2 /bin/redis-cli "$@" 2>/dev/null; }      # a 2 s client deadline
list_tok() { local l; l=$(tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//'); echo "[$l]"; }   # LRANGE lines -> [e1,e2,...]

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  hydo_hist kv 0 invoke write k:$i v$i
  if [ "$(rc SET k:$i v$i)" = OK ]; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; hydo_hist kv 0 ok write k:$i v$i
  else hydo_hist kv 0 info write k:$i v$i; fi
  l=l$((i % 3))
  hydo_hist log 1 invoke append $l $i
  case "$(rc RPUSH $l $i)" in [0-9]*) hydo_hist log 1 ok append $l $i;; *) hydo_hist log 1 info append $l $i;; esac
  hydo_hist log 2 invoke read $l
  if out=$(rc LRANGE $l 0 -1); then hydo_hist log 2 ok read $l $(printf '%s' "$out" | list_tok)
  else hydo_hist log 2 info read $l; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

checks.msg: every SET and GET is linearizable per key (an acknowledged SET is never lost)
checks.final:
i=0
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_STEPS ]; do
  hydo_hist kv 9 invoke read k:$i
  if v=$(rc GET k:$i); then hydo_hist kv 9 ok read k:$i ${v:-nil}; else hydo_hist kv 9 info read k:$i; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

checks.msg: the lists never lose an acknowledged RPUSH, never duplicate one, and reads never go back in time
checks.final:
for l in l0 l1 l2; do
  hydo_hist log 9 invoke read $l
  if out=$(rc LRANGE $l 0 -1); then hydo_hist log 9 ok read $l $(printf '%s' "$out" | list_tok)
  else hydo_hist log 9 info read $l; fi
done
